item.text: {"summary":"A perennial deciduous grass native to the Atlantic coast of the Americas from Newfoundland to northern Argentina, saltmarsh cordgrass dominates some brackish coastal marshes. Its sharply tapered leaves bend at the tips, while flowers and seeds grow on only one side of the stalk. At marsh edges, it extends into the water and accumulates sediment.","humanEdibility":"unknown","edibilityNote":null,"evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p2","s1:p3"],"humanEdibility":[]}}
